landing.compute.title: VM, GPU, vCPU, and storage resource allocation
landing.compute.body: Allocate the GPU, vCPU, memory, and storage needed for GPU-accelerated VMs within project quotas to prepare individual experimental environments right away.
landing.cluster.title: Kubernetes practice and experimental environments
landing.cluster.body: Configure K8s cluster nodes, deploy Pods and workloads for courses and research projects, and track their status in the console.
landing.library.title: AI/ML library layers
landing.library.body: Manage frameworks and data processing tools that require repeated installation as immutable layers to reuse and fork team environments.
landing.governance.title: Operational controls for instructors and administrators
landing.governance.body: Bring projects, users, roles, quotas, monitoring, and audit logs together to maintain lab-wide operational standards.
landing.governance.proof: Roles and boundaries in one place
landing.workflow.computeBody: Researchers select the images, flavors, networks, and keys they need to prepare experimental instances.
landing.workflow.dataAlt: Collage of shared data spaces and snapshot workflows
landing.workflow.dataBody: Keep team data and experimental results safely available with file storage and snapshots.
landing.workflow.clusterBody: Create Kubernetes clusters for each course or project and track node configurations.
landing.workflow.observeBody: Quickly identify usage and bottlenecks through metric-based screens.
landing.workflow.securityBody: Reduce multitenant risks with permission boundaries, encryption with separated keys, and operation logs.

landing.hero.title:
An operations console
that makes lab clouds easier to deliver
landing.hero.lead: Afterglow is a cloud portal designed for professors, researchers, and practice teams to request and operate compute resources, shared storage, Kubernetes environments, and AI/ML library layers in one place.
landing.hero.projectFact: Resource boundaries for each research team
landing.overview.label: Operational scope
landing.overview.title:
Delivering a cloud goes
beyond creating resources
landing.overview.body: In a lab, user invitations, project quotas, images and networks, data sharing, GPU usage, practice clusters, and audit logs are all intertwined. Afterglow brings this workflow together in a console research organizations can understand.
landing.overview.proofBody: Operators see the entire workflow, and researchers access the environments they need directly.
landing.capabilities.title:
Bring together the interfaces
needed to deliver a research cloud
landing.capabilities.body: Users need to start experiments, operators need to maintain boundaries, and instructors need to see resource flows across teams.
landing.workflow.title:
Explore each lab’s workflows
with a change of filter
landing.workflow.body: Switch between compute, data, and operations contexts to see the resources and status you need in one workflow.
